speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health what steps is the Ministry taking to raise awareness of regular strength training and resistance activity to mitigate the effects of muscle loss and to maintain functional independence among middle-aged and older Singaporeans.

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health what plans does the Ministry have to support safe and guided strength training for middle-aged and older Singaporeans and less active adults who may lack confidence or knowledge to use gym equipment effectively.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: With this expansion, plus the Healthy 365 app, we can better reach out to seniors and engage them in strength training exercises.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Ms Mariam Jaafar, you have a supplementary question?

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
text: I am asking actually not really for senior seniors, who I think are supported by the AACs.

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
text: But in my house visits, I have gotten an increasing number of people in their 40s and 50s who do not really want to exercise with seniors but who are starting to feel on their holidays that they are getting tired easily and things like that.

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
text: My second supplementary question is for middle — did the Minister of State answer Question Nos 1 and 2, or just Question No 1?

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
text: My second supplementary question is for the middle aged and older group, people in their 40s and 50s who are less active today, but want to start and lack the confidence to start with gym equipment.

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
text: How does the Ministry ensure that there are programmes that are safely-guided and appropriately-paced through ActiveSG gyms and other community partners?

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
text: And strength training is expanded under Healthier SG; so, how will the Ministry ensure that there are enough venues as well as enough trained instructors to provide a consistent quality and safe venues?

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
text: And I will bring in my Parliamentary Question (PQ) for written answer – which is a request, whether the Ministry will consider working with the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) to get an ActiveSG facility in the Admiralty part of Woodlands where there currently is not any; today, they have to go to Woodlands Swimming Complex which has the only ActiveSG facility in the area, or Sembawang.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: The data though, I do not have the details with me.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: If the Member is interested in some of those, she could file a further PQ on that.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: On the second question, relating to those who may not be as familiar with the gym equipment, I can imagine the concern and how we want to encourage people to use the gyms more.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: And so, I hope these are things that will encourage some of the new users to use the gyms more often.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: On the third question, I know that Ms Mariam Jaafar is asking for her constituency and I am sure many others feel the same way.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: At the moment, the Healthy 365 app is quite comprehensive.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, there are already in existence many opportunities in places.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Perhaps, we could look at where the gaps are and look at how we can improve on that.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: I would encourage those of your residents whom you say are not very familiar and are lethargic, and they do want to seek some guidance, the Healthy 365 app does provide a very good starting point and perhaps, that could be an initial introduction to a change in healthy living of the residents.
